about: Taste notes the agent uses to score events (0-100). Top-level likes/lessLikely are Ian (first person); Emily is under people.emily. Shared household likes appear in both. Flags on the calendar are learned on top of this.

family.rule: On family days, actively include family-friendly / kid-friendly events (kids-only programming is OK) alongside the usual adult events. On other days, skip kids-only programming.

alternatingSaturdays.note: Family Saturdays are 2026-10-31 and every 14 days after (11/14, 11/28, 12/12, ...). The Saturdays in between are not family days.

family.ageNote: Kids are 4 and 10. Prefer events that work for both ages together (zoo, COSI, parks, festivals, family concerts, library programs); toddler-only or teen-only events score lower.
